Functional Design Document
Cheque processing
5
Functional Specifications
Introduction

Background
PNB is the market leader for unit trust business in Malaysia. PNB’s objective is to provide excellent unit trust services, innovative solutions for their customers and agents as well. The scope of work is to enhance  current .net version of FCIS application to FCIS 14.4.0.0.0 base product with functionalities required for PNB.
Organization of the Document
The first chapter of this document gives an introduction with brief background and organization of the document.  Subsequent chapters cover the details of the actual enhancements.
Acronyms and Abbreviations

Requirements Summary
The enhancements scoped in the document are relating to the Cheque processing that were customized for PNB as part of .Net enhancements. The Details are covered in the Traceability Matrix section. The summary of requirements is as below:
Cheque printing
Cheque Status
GAP/New requirements are not part of this FS, these new Gaps will be discussed separately in detail and cover in different FS.

Cheque Processing
Requirements Overview
PNB makes payment to its unit holders and other entities through both cash and Cheque. The entire activities related to payment through Cheque except bank reconciliation is required to be handled in their proposed fund distribution system. The unique requirement is that one bank account is assigned to each function i.e.
Cheque printing to be integrated with the transaction screen i.e. on completion of transaction, Cheque printing should be available.
Transmission Cheque to be printed for beneficiary

Third party redemption Cheque payment to be available to print
Provision to re-print a Cheque in case not printed correctly or lost or wrong payee details.
Facility to track the Cheque status and make the Cheque status changes
Existing Functionality
Existing screen in AGY and FMGCheque printing (UTDCHKPR) screen can be used to initiate the printing of checks for Dividend payments, redemption payments, payment of fee or incentives etc..

Existing screen in FMGCheque status summary (UTDCHKST) screen support to view Cheque status and allow to change the Cheque status as invalid or lost.
Assumptions
Type of Cheque ‘Additional Khairat’ will be out of scope to upgrade in J2EE in both screens Cheque printing and Cheque status
EPF redemption is always captured as Money transfer in EPF redemption screen hence the EPF redemption Cheque is out of scope for upgrade in J2EE
Dividend Cheques are extracted for printing by external system, this will be scoped in interface integration/Interfaces release

Cheque Preview screen development is not in current scope. it will be covered as part of future development
Cheque status upload will be covered as part of separate interface FDD
PPRT loans repayment (From Dividend) is handled outside the system so Loan repayment Cheque will be out of scope for upgrade in J2EE

Processing Changes
Cheque Printing
User can printing the Cheque in AGY or FMGCheque printing UTDCHKPR screen

First User has to provide the details in search criteria such as Type of Cheque, Printing option, Output type, Fund Id, Amount range and click on ‘OK’ button
Based on the above Search Criteria, system will fetch the Cheque records and display in Cheque details section if the user selected the ‘Display Records for selecting’ as Yes
User can select the Cheque record and click on ‘Preview button’ to print the Cheque
Cheque date field in FMGCheque printing (UTDCHKPR) screen will show by default as current application date while displaying Cheques which are pending to print, existing validation which does not allow the user to enter the back date in Cheque date field will remain and user will be allowed to give Cheque date as future date
System will be restricted to display the following types of Cheques in FMGCheque printing screen UTDCHKPR

Dividend
Redemption
Subscription /IPO
Transmission
Forced selling cases

Third party Redemption-Invoking Block
Cancel Transaction
Hibah/Trust Declaration Claim
Second Transmission
Third party Redemption Bankruptcy

Redemption Allocation will be enhanced to extract the data for printing the Cheques online.
For historical pricing funds, redemption Cheque will be printed immediately on successful allocation of Redemption transaction using the redemption confirmation printing screen
For forward pricing funds, redemption Cheque will be printed after EOD batch allocation in FMG Cheque printing screen UTDCHKPR
User can re-print or re-issue the redemption Cheque from AGY or FMGCheque printing screen as duplicate Cheque
Once the redemption transaction Cheque is printing for all types of redemption, Cheque number will be updated for that redemption transaction under tab settlement details in field ‘Cheque number’

If the redemption Cheque is re-issued then the latest Cheque number will be updated in that redemption transaction screen under tab settlement detail in field Cheque number
This is applicable to all front teller and back office out going Cheques
System will extract the Cheque data in daily EOD batch with activity ‘Payment Data Extraction’ for following type of Cheques:
Transmission
Forced selling cases

Hibah/Trust Declaration Claim
Third party Redemption-Invoking Block
Second Transmission
Third party Redemption Bankruptcy
Once the EOD batch ‘Payment data extraction’ is executed successfully, Cheque data will be available for printing

User can print these Cheque by selecting particular type of Cheque in FMGCheque printing screen UTDCHKPR and preview the Cheque to print it
During Beneficiary detail capture in Transmission screen, user will specify whether Cheque printing is required or not. If user specifies, Cheque printing is not required, (Suppress Cheque is ticked) then, system will generate payables for each beneficiary, however the payment type will be marked as Manual Cheque. Provision will be provided so that the user can retrieve those records and update the Manual Cheque number individually against each payable in AGYTransmission manual Cheque update screen. These Transmission Cheques will not be available for printing in Cheque printing screen UTDCHKPR.
For historical pricing funds, Cancel Transaction Cheque will be printed immediately on successful allocation of Redemption transaction using the redemption confirmation printing screen
For forward pricing funds, cancel redemption Cheque will be printed after EOD batch allocation in FMG Cheque printing screen UTDCHKPR
Cheques can be printed in a bulk based on Cheque type as required

Cheque status summary screen
Existing Check Status Summary screen UTDCHKST in FMG will be used for tracking the status of the Cheque or changing the Cheque status.
Cheque status summary screen UTDCHKST will be also available in AGY module, the Drop down in field ‘type of Cheque’ will show only three values as Bonus, Redemption, Subscription /IPO
At the time of Cheque data extraction for Cheque printing itself the status of the Cheque will be ‘READY’ for printing.
If the Cheque has been printed in FMGCheque printing screen UTDCHKPR, the status will be automatically updated as ACTIVE.

If the unit holder has reported the loss of a Cheque, user has to update the Cheque status to STOP.
If the Cheque status is already marked as Cleared, Cheque status change to STOP will not be allowed.
User will be allowed to change the Cheque status only as ‘STOP’, other status will be automatically triggered in the system.
Cheque status will be updated by system as ‘EXPIRED’ in AGY/FMGCheque status summary screen, Daily EOD task will trigger to mark all ACTIVE Cheques to EXPIRED if six months have crossed since the date of issue.
Example: Cheque was issued on 1-Jan-2020, if no one claims this Cheque on or before 1-July-2020 then on 2-July-2020 BOD batch will trigger and make the Cheque status as ‘Expired’ in Cheque status summary screen

Cheque will be updated by system as ‘UNCLAIMED’ once in year in FMGCheque status summary screen UTDCHKST if the Cheque remained unpaid for a period of more than one year, on every 31st -Dec BOD task will trigger and mark all EXPIRED Cheques to UNCLAIMED if one year has crossed since the date of issue.
Example 1: Cheque was issued to UH on 10/2/2010, Cheque status was ACTIVE.
When it crossed six (6) months (180 days), on 10/8/2010, system will update the Cheque status from ACTIVE to EXPIRED.
This Cheque will reach one (1) year on 10/2/2011 but system will update the Cheque status from EXPIRED to UNCLAIMED on 1st-Jan-2012 during the BOD batch processing
Example 2: Cheque was issued to UH on 26/10/2010, Cheque status was ACTIVE.

When it reached six (6) months, on 26/03/2011, system will update the Cheque status from ACTIVE to EXPIRED.
This Cheque will reach one (1) year on 26/10/2011 but system will update the Cheque status from EXPIRED to UNCLAIMED on 1st-Jan-2012 during the BOD batch processing
Example 3: Cheque was issued to UH on 31/12/2010, Cheque status was ACTIVE.
When it reached six (6) months, on 30/06/2011, system will update the Cheque status from ACTIVE to EXPIRED.
This Cheque will reach one (1) year on 31/12/2011, system will update the Cheque status from EXPIRED to UNCLAIMED on 1st-Jan-2012 during the BOD batch processing

Cheque status will be updated by system as ‘DUPLICATE’ when the Cheque is selected for re-issue and re-printed it
To see the Cheque replacement history for a particular Cheque, user can specify the Cheque transaction number in new search criteria field ‘Cheque Txn No’ in FMGCheque status summary screen UTDCHKST, system will show the list of all old Cheque details for that transaction in Cheque details section and the listing will be in the stopped/reissued order, new Cheque number will be displayed first.
Cheque Re-issue
In order to re-issue the Cheque, first user has to change the Cheque status as ‘Stop’ in AGY or FMGCheque status summary screen UTDCHKST.
Once the Cheque status is changed as ‘Stop’, it will be allowed to re-issue as Duplicate Cheque in AGY or FMGCheque printing screen

Once the Duplicate Cheque is printed, system will update the new Cheque number in column ‘New Cheque No’ in AGY/FMGCheque status summary screen UTDCHKST
User can select the field ‘Duplicate Cheque’ as Yes and search Cheques by providing the search criteria
Re-issue Reason column in Cheque detail section will be enable when user selected the duplicate field as Yes
Re-issue reason column will have values as Invalid, Lost, wrong payee, Damaged, Others
If Re-issue reason is selected as ‘Wrong Payee’ then Payee details button enable, when user clicked this button system will pops up window where user can correct the payee details, details of payee details fields given in Maintenance in section 4.4.18

User can select the Cheque for re-issue and click on ‘Preview’ button to print the Cheque
In case the Cheque is not printed correctly, user can go for re-printing the Cheques
Re-issue/Duplicate issue of Cheque will be allowed from the branch of issue only.
Example: Branch A is issued one redemption Cheque, same Cheque can be re-issued by the same Branch only which is Branch A, other Branches are not allowed to re-issue that Cheque
Counter Foils

For all types of Cheques, on the first half the counterfoil details will be printed and on the next half the Cheque details will be printed. The information printed on the counter foil and Cheque depends on the type of payment.
Note: Cheque Preview screen development is not in current scope. it will be covered as part of report development
